name: ops-guards
description: Three guards for tabs and drivers: one heavy install or build at a time across sessions, secrets never reach the model, and no force push, git clean -x or junction-following delete.

heavyLock.title: Heavy-work lock
heavyLock.description: Make installs and builds wait their turn across tabs and the nightly scheduler.

redaction.title: Key redaction
redaction.description: Strip secrets from tool output and refuse reads of ~/.capsid/*.key and .mcp.json.

destructiveGuard.title: Destructive-command guard
destructiveGuard.description: Refuse force pushes, git clean -x, and recursive deletes of a tree holding a node_modules junction.
